tex_content.label: noloops
tex_content.html:
No nonconstant sub-geodesic of any $D_x$ is an embedded null-homotopic loop in $A$.
Proof

\sketch Such a loop has turning $\pi $ minus its closing angle. Since $K\le 1$ and the enclosed area is below $\mu <\pi $, Gauss–Bonnet is impossible.

□

For a disk $B$ cut off by some $D_x$, a unit arc $J\subset c_0\cap B$, and $X_J=X\cap J$, stop each $D_y$, $y\in X_J$, at its first encounter with $\partial B$ and denote the resulting strip by $S_{X_J}(B)$.

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Local embedding of the geodesic family near a component of XJ]
